skill.name: weibo-content-research
skill.description: Research Weibo hot searches and keyword results through SocialDataX to support content planning, competitor comparisons, and source-based analysis.
skill.summary: Explore Weibo topics and content samples with traceable evidence through SocialDataX CLI or available MCP tools.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: One finding is confirmed: direct CLI examples execute an unpinned npm package with automatic approval. The remaining 34 findings reflect Markdown formatting, documented service links, intended authentication, and readable multilingual text. No evidence found of credential theft, obfuscation, or audit-directed prompt injection in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: The CLI examples execute socialdatax-skills@latest through npx -y, allowing unreviewed package releases to run with local permissions.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version and lock dependencies. Require approval for initial installation and updates, and restrict runtime access to necessary credentials.

content.user_title: Research Weibo Topics and Content Samples
content.value_statement: Content planning needs current Weibo signals and traceable examples rather than unsupported trend claims. This skill guides SocialDataX queries and separates retrieved evidence from interpretation.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve current Weibo hot-search rankings through the documented CLI or available MCP tool.
Search Weibo posts using focused keywords.
Limit collection by page count or item count and continue using returned pagination tokens.
Organize content samples with available post IDs, links, author facts, engagement metrics, and publication times.
Separate hot-search signals, keyword results, visible evidence, and analytical judgments.
Preserve partial results and resume within the original collection limits after recoverable failures.
limitations: Requires a SocialDataX API key, network access, and sufficient service balance.
Direct CLI use requires Node.js and npm; the external package implementation is not included in the reviewed files.
Search does not support exhaustive collection, and rankings or engagement signals do not prove broader audience sentiment.
Read-only research does not include account login, posting, likes, comments, or account changes.

use_cases.title: Plan timely content
use_cases.description: Review hot-search signals and related post samples before selecting topics for an editorial schedule.

use_cases.title: Compare competitor messaging
use_cases.description: Search brand-specific keywords and compare visible themes, examples, and engagement indicators without claiming complete market coverage.

use_cases.title: Collect source-based inspiration
use_cases.description: Gather a small set of relevant posts and retain references while developing new content angles.

prompt_templates.title: Review hot searches
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve current Weibo hot searches. Summarize available rankings and heat signals, keeping observations separate from suggested content angles.

prompt_templates.title: Collect keyword samples
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Weibo for [keyword] and collect one page. Preserve available post links, authors, engagement metrics, and publication times.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: build a focused evidence sample.

prompt_templates.title: Compare two brands
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Weibo for [brand A] and [brand B], limiting each search to 20 posts. Compare themes and available engagement signals. Cite supporting posts.

prompt_templates.title: Build a bounded research brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [topic] using hot searches and keyword results. Collect at most three search pages or 50 posts, whichever limit comes first. Preserve partial results. Resume only with returned continuation tokens. Separate evidence, judgments, and gaps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: manage collection limits and recovery.

output_examples.input: Show the expected format for a Weibo hot-search brief.
output: Illustrative format only; no live results are represented.
Hot-search evidence: list each returned topic with its available rank and heat signal.
Content angles: distinguish suggestions from observed ranking data.
Coverage: record retrieval time and identify missing fields.

output_examples.input: Show how a keyword research brief should handle incomplete results.
output: Illustrative format only; no posts or metrics are invented.
Evidence: retain returned post references, author facts, engagement metrics, and publication times when available.
Interpretation: compare visible themes without claiming that the sample represents all Weibo users.
Collection status: label partial results and continue only with a returned token within the remaining limits.

best_practices: Start with one page and a focused keyword before increasing collection limits.
Retain source references and separate retrieved facts from analytical judgments.
Review and pin the CLI package before execution, keep API keys private, and approve any required installation changes.
anti_patterns: Treating a hot-search ranking or small post sample as proof of overall public sentiment.
Restarting partial searches from the first page without respecting the original collection limits.
Sharing API keys in prompts, reports, or troubleshooting output.

faq.question: What do I need before using this skill?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and ensure network access and sufficient balance. Direct CLI use also requires Node.js and npm.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude or Codex?
faq.answer: The skill lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code support. Execution depends on shell access or an already available compatible MCP connection.

faq.question: Does it modify my Weibo account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow is read-only. It does not log in, publish posts, like content, comment, or change accounts.

faq.question: Can it collect every matching post?
faq.answer: No. Search has no stable complete-result boundary and does not support --all. Use explicit page and item limits.

faq.question: What happens when a query fails?
faq.answer: Preserve partial results and errors. Resume with the returned token within remaining limits, and stop repeated retries when balance is insufficient.

faq.question: Are the CLI instructions independently verified as safe?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed files contain instructions, not the external package implementation. The examples execute an unpinned latest package with automatic approval.
